name: Target Species
description: Primary species targeted by the product.

name: Food Form
description: Physical form of food, treat, or chemical product.

name: Primary Protein / Flavor
description: Main flavor or animal protein source (e.g. Chicken, Beef, Salmon, Lamb, Peanut Butter).

name: Package Weight / Volume
description: Standardized package size (e.g. 4 lb, 30 lb, 12.5 oz, 1 gal).

name: Organic / Natural Status
description: Indicates if the product is certified organic or all-natural.
